verdict.rationale: Resend supports bulk operations via batch email sending (up to 100 emails per request) and broadcasts to full audience/contact lists, plus contact/segment management for marketing bulk sends. However, batch API is explicitly capped at 100 items per call, and there's no evidence of higher-volume bulk primitives (e.g., bulk domain/webhook management, bulk suppression add) beyond individual endpoints. missing for 10: evidence of uncapped or higher-limit bulk operations, bulk management APIs outside email/broadcast, independent hands-on confirmation of batch reliability at scale.
